scope: dependencies that must be removed, isolated or explicitly replaced before a portable tenant baseline can be applied

dependencies.purpose: The baseline assumes these provider-managed schemas already exist before the artifact is applied.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: a clean PostgreSQL baseline cannot retain implicit provider schemas; each schema must be replaced by an application-owned schema, an object-storage adapter boundary, or a provider-neutral migration ledger.

dependencies.object: public.team_members.auth_user_id -> auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
dependencies.purpose: Associates a dashboard membership with a Supabase Auth user subject.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: preserving the provider subject in the canonical membership model would lock business data to Supabase Auth; the FK must become an application-owned user/mapping boundary while preserving nullable membership semantics.

dependencies.purpose: Maps the current Supabase request subject to an active team member and admin predicate used by RLS policies.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: replacing the function without an equivalent request-scoped actor context could allow anonymous, inactive or cross-user access; the non-owner and non-BYPASSRLS intent must remain explicit.

dependencies.purpose: Provider request roles define table RLS, public/anonymous denial, authenticated member reads, and service-only function execution.
dependencies.migration_risk: critical: blindly replacing service_role with a database owner would bypass RLS and violate the server-owned API contract; the new runtime must use an authenticated application API and a non-owner, non-BYPASSRLS database role.

dependencies.object: postgres object ownership and Supabase-managed default ACL behavior
dependencies.purpose: The dump restores objects owned by postgres and then reasserts grants because provider default ACLs are not preserved by the dump.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: a portable apply must separate migration-owner, runtime and application roles; replaying provider ACL assumptions can silently grant future tables or make RLS ineffective.

dependencies.purpose: The only provider metadata DML in v053 provisions a private lead-photo bucket and intentionally omits the internal agent bucket.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: PostgreSQL DML cannot provision the selected object-storage provider; moving only the bucket row would lose bytes, signed access policy, key isolation and checksum evidence.

dependencies.object: storage.objects and its authenticated/anonymous access policies
dependencies.purpose: Clean-room verification exercises active-member photo reads, rejects inactive and anonymous reads, and checks that the agent bucket is absent.
dependencies.migration_risk: critical: Storage objects and policy evaluation are outside a portable PostgreSQL business baseline; omitting this dependency can expose private photos or orphan object keys during cutover.

dependencies.purpose: Tenant runners record v053 as the first applied version and then consume only shared 054+ deltas.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: treating the historical Supabase ledger as a portable catalog would replay 001-052 or mark a partially applied tenant as complete; S08 needs a provider-neutral ledger and two clean applies.

dependencies.object: REST exposure of public tables/views/RPCs with PostgREST pagination and merge-duplicates semantics
dependencies.purpose: The browser and sync agent use the public schema through REST; the current code relies on the 1000-row cap, allowlisted table access, and upsert conflict behavior.
dependencies.migration_risk: critical: direct browser/database and privileged REST transport cannot remain in the Neon design; an API replacement must preserve pagination, UTC filtering, idempotency and authorization without exposing database credentials.

dependencies.object: Supabase Auth client, access-token claims, sessions, password reset and admin user operations
dependencies.purpose: Provides the current browser/session lifecycle and maps Auth subjects to team_members rows.
dependencies.migration_risk: critical: sessions and password hashes are not portable cutover data; replacing the SDK without invite/reset/disable/CSRF/session-revocation tests can leave stale access or break all four users.

dependencies.object: Storage bucket provisioning, uploads and signed download URLs
dependencies.purpose: The application and operations adapter provision lead-photos and render private photo objects through Supabase APIs.
dependencies.migration_risk: high: changing only the URL or bucket name is insufficient; server-side signing, missing/forbidden-key behavior, object manifests and agent-artifact separation must be proven.

dependencies.object: Supabase service_role key and service-role REST/RPC transport
dependencies.purpose: The sync agent and server handlers currently perform privileged upserts, RPCs, Auth admin calls and Storage operations through the Supabase service role.
dependencies.migration_risk: critical: copying service_role into Neon or a machine config would create a tenant-wide owner credential; the replacement must be server-owned and machine-scoped with replay, revoke and transaction tests.

dependencies.purpose: Records the installed source extensions separately from the one extension declared by the schema-only v053 artifact.
dependencies.migration_risk: medium: restoring the whole source extension set would import operational and Supabase-only state; the portable baseline must require only pgcrypto and verify the remaining extensions explicitly before clean-room acceptance.

dependencies.object: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
dependencies.purpose: Supplies gen_random_uuid() defaults used by UUID business keys and mutation identifiers.
dependencies.migration_risk: medium: this extension is portable in principle but its availability, version, ownership and grants must be checked on the selected Neon PostgreSQL version; a missing extension breaks clean apply.

dependencies.purpose: Records the explicit requirement that the selected portable baseline must not depend on the Supabase-only vault extension.
dependencies.migration_risk: medium: an undeclared vault reference would have no accepted Neon replacement and could fail schema apply or leak a hidden secret dependency; the inventory must keep proving absence.

dependencies.purpose: The current application does not use Realtime; this is recorded so a future schema/runtime review does not invent a replacement dependency.
dependencies.migration_risk: none for the current baseline; any later subscription requirement would be a separately scoped provider-port decision and must not be smuggled into S04.
